body_markdown:
Water Tower Research’s new research report takes a close look at how eXoZymes is moving from a promising scientific platform toward a potentially scalable commercial business.


The report identifies NCT as the company’s most important near-term opportunity and highlights the dramatic progress made in taking it from laboratory development toward commercial production. It also explores the much larger opportunity behind the platform - including potential pharmaceutical applications, cannabinoids, santalene and a pipeline of new molecules - while outlining the milestones that could determine how quickly eXoZymes can turn its technology into partnerships, products and revenue.
